name: Click Recorder
description: Records your own clicks as .gdr2 files and replays them in the level.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: <cy>Record</c> saves your clicks. <cg>Replay</c> plays the chosen click file. <cr>Off</c> does nothing.

replay-file.name: Replay file
replay-file.description: The .gdr2 click file to play in Replay mode.

save-on-death.name: Save failed attempts
save-on-death.description: In Record mode, also save a click file when you die, not only when you beat the level.

tps.name: Ticks per second
tps.description: The physics tick rate your game runs at. Leave at 240 unless you changed it with a TPS mod.

show-notifications.name: Show notifications
show-notifications.description: Show a message when a recording is saved or a replay starts.
